5276-5332-6495-6524.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Evereth by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
5276-5332-6495-6524.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

833-1059-3827-5621.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-3827-5621.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Arid Archway, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1235-4867-6898.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}.
Electro triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2741-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3617-4423-6886-7705.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
3617-4423-6886-7705.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

2086-2292-6996.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

206-914-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
206-914-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1806-2034-2060-6774-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

413-465-3175.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2099-6972-7153.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

413-1003-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2173-4905-5220-5332.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3609-6750-6807.notablePrerequisites: Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3609-6750-6807.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Vedalken Infuser triggers, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1462-2239-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-2239-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-2239-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

413-2506-2721.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it, Blasting Station and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
If a Vampire or Wizard was returned to the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer token's trigger, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2498-3017-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3017-3591-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

647-851-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3995-6287-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with toughness 6 or greater.
3995-6287-6478.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Arbor Adherent.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Horseshoe Crab.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

913-3525-5390-5516.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
913-3525-5390-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
913-3525-5390-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

2538-3139-3558-3676.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, causing you to return Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3585-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-3585-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

526-2781-2959.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-2781-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Felidar Guardian token.
Repeat from step 2.

342-2206-2948-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Initiates of the Ebon Hand and Gingerbrute.
Activate Gingerbrute by paying {0}, adding {B}.
Repeat step 3.

254-2906-3100-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.You have at least two opponents.
Opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn plus an additional 2 life for each time you've cast Codie from the command zone this game, minus 1 life for each opponent you have beyond the second.
254-2906-3100-3371.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Lampad of Death's Vigil by paying {1} and sacrificing Codie.
Choose to return Codie to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Lampad of Death's Vigil trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Codie from the command zone by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Codie and giving it haste.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo ends once you have one opponent remaining, as the lifeloss from Lampad of Death's Vigil no longer covers Codie's increased commander tax.
However, you may be able to get more iterations if you started the combo with three or more opponents, as Rakdos will decrease Codie's cost by {3}, outpacing the {2} from commander tax, until you have two or less opponents.
Once you have a large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 13 for each remaining trigger.

244-1840-2544-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Filigree Sages.
244-1840-2544-5149.description:
Cast False Dawn by paying {1}{W}.
Activate Component Pouch's second ability by tapping it, causing you to roll a d20 and put at least one component counter on it.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, or by paying {W} due to False Dawn, untapping Component Pouch.
Activate Component Pouch's first ability by tapping it and removing a component counter from it, adding {W}{W} which can be spent as mana of any color due to False Dawn.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {W}, untapping Component Pouch.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite component counters on Component Pouch, you may forego steps 2 and 3 to get infinite colored mana.

1981-2270-4378.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to cause the additional creature to die.
It is not your turn.
1981-2270-4378.description:
During an opponent's turn, cause the additional creature to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain one life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield as a 0/-1 due to Vibrating Sphere and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

588-4437.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
588-4437.description:
Cast Aether Snap by paying {3}{B}{B}, removing all counters from all permanents.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Celestial Convergence triggers, causing you to win the game.

876-956-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Bringer of the White Dawn triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Coretapper.
Repeat.

851-893-1651.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Myr tokens, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

1300-2816-3993-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four other Shrines.
1300-2816-3993-4050.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Life's Web triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Honden of Life's Web's ability.
Resolve the copy of Honden of Life's Web's ability, creating at least five 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Spirit tokens, adding {3}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

500-2743-3129.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Biovisionary and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
End your turn.
All the Biovisionaries trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, winning the game.

527-776-3940.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
Less mana is required if you control a creature with greater than 2 power and/or you have already cast one or more spells this turn.
527-776-3940.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to the power of the highest power among creatures you control.
Cast Haze of Rage with its buyback cost by paying {3}{R}.
Haze of Rage's storm ability and Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving your creatures +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Haze of Rage's storm ability, copying it once for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage copies,, giving creatures you control +1/+0 per spell you've cast this turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

2050-3525-3547.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Grafted Growth attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-3547.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Grafted Growth, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.
